errors.description: The model hallucinated the existence of a 'light blue' and 'purple' line that were not present in the video. The Scene Description explicitly states only 6 ropes were generated — yellow, orange, green, blue, red, and white — with no mention of light blue or purple. The model invented two additional lines, leading to an inflated count of 7 instead of the correct 6. This is not a misperception of color but a complete fabrication of objects not present in the visual input.

analysis_result.analysis: The model failed by hallucinating two additional lines (light blue and purple) not present in the video, resulting in an incorrect count of 7 instead of the ground truth of 6. This is a severe perception-level error rooted in object invention, not misidentification or miscounting of actual visible elements. The model’s reasoning was internally consistent — it counted each of the 7 lines it claimed to see — but the foundational perception was factually wrong. No reasoning or math error occurred beyond this initial hallucination.
